turns.assessment: The only positive optical symptom is a pre-FEC BER increase at the S15 receiver trx.och32.z, while its receive power, estimated OSNR, DGD and SOP rate—and the monitored optical path—show no change. That pattern strongly identifies receiver-local degradation rather than a span, amplifier, or power fault. The concentration of affected SNCP services is consistent with traffic using the lightpath terminating at this receiver.

proposals.rationale: O1 is an isolated pre-FEC BER increase at this receiver with unchanged optical power, OSNR, DGD, SOP rate, and upstream path telemetry, matching the documented receiver-local RX_PENALTY signature.
A channel-specific filter shift could reduce quality without changing power, but the broad absence of upstream changes and receiver-local signature make it less likely.
Margin erosion can appear at a receiver, but it is normally gradual; the observed discrete BER change better fits RX_DEGRADATION.
